Defines interface IControlsPanel for multi-tab control panels.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.controls.icontrols_panel.IControlsPanel(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Interface for robot streamer, validation, and jog control panels.

It defines:

methods:

append_log - Appends message to terminal log console.
update_progress - Updates streamer progress bar and metrics.
